lines.text: Amos tells the women of Samaria who oppress the poor that they will be taken away with hooks.
The LORD tells Israel to go to Bethel and Gilgal and rebel, bringing tithes every three days.
The LORD brought lack of bread and withheld rain when the harvest was six months away, yet Israel did not return.
The LORD sent plagues like those of Moab and overthrew some of Israel as He overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
The LORD tells Israel to prepare to meet their God, who forms the mountains and creates the wind.
